Package com.btcvelocity.api.queue

Interface QueueManager

public interface QueueManager
Manages the queue system for the proxy.

The queue manager maintains one Queue per registered backend server. In a multi-proxy Redis setup, exactly one proxy acts as the master and is responsible for running periodic transfer and server-ping tasks.
